== 1st Quest ==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D || E
|-
!width="5%" | 1
!width="19%" rowspan="2" | ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 5|Section 5]]''
|width="19%"|
|width="19%"|
|width="19%"|In this very important cave, you can obtain the {{im/loz|Item|White Sword}}, but only if you have at least 5 Heart Containers in your Life Meter.  The White Sword has double the power of the Wooden Sword.
|width="19%"|Reach this area to find the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 5|fifth dungeon]], but beware; the distance you must hike up the hills to reach the top can be deceptive.
|-
! 2
|
|
|The waterfall hides a secret cave, where you can learn from the old lady how to get over the Lost Hills if you give her 20 rupees. If you pay less, she won't tell you anything.
|These are the Lost Hills.  Unprepared wanderers can feel as if they are making no progress through this area, but persistent climbers know that the only way to reach the top is to keep climbing.
|-
! 3
|If you bomb the north wall all the way to the right, you will uncover the entrance to a medicine woman. If you have shown her the letter, she will sell you a {{im/loz|Item|Red Potion}} for 68 rupees or a {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}} for 40 rupees.
|Just before the entrance to the desert, burn the lower rightmost tree to reveal a stairwell.  Down the stairs is a {{im/loz|Enemy|Red Moblin}} that will donate 30 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}} to your cause.
|
|
|
|-
! 4
|Inside the tree, you will discover [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 1|level one]].
|Travel west along the bridge to find the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 1|first dungeon]].
!''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 4|Section 4]]''

== 2nd Quest ==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D || E
|-
!width="5%" | 1
!width="19%" rowspan="2" | ''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 5|Section 5]]''

|width="19%"|
|width="19%"|Right next to the cave with the White Sword, but a great journey away, Link can obtain the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Sword}} if he has at least 12 total Heart Containers.  Push the left most boulder to reveal the stairwell that leads to the sword.
|width="19%"|In this very important cave, you can obtain the {{im/loz|Item|White Sword}}, but only if you have at least 5 Heart Containers in your Life Meter.  The White Sword has double the power of the Wooden Sword.
|width="19%"|By climbing to the very top of the Lost Hills, you will find a well-deserved life giving Fairy Fountain.
|-
! 2
|If you have the ladder, you can bomb the cliff wall along the right side of this area to reveal a cave.  Inside you will find a medicine woman who will sell you the {{im/loz|Item|Red Potion}} for 68 rupees or the {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}} for 40 rupees if you have already shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}}.
|If you have the ladder, bomb the left side of the cliff wall to reveal the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 8|eighth dungeon]].
|The waterfall hides a secret cave where information can be bought.  The more you pay, the better the info.
|These are the Lost Hills.  While the top contains a Fairy Fountain, it is more important to push the rightmost boulder to reveal the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 4|fourth dungeon]].
|-
! 3
|
|Just before the entrance to the desert, burn the lower rightmost tree to reveal a stairwell.  Down the stairs is a {{im/loz|Enemy|Red Moblin}} that will donate 30 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}} to your cause.
|The desert in the 2nd Quest holds many more secrets which must be revealed by using the {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}}.  If you blow the whistle here, you will reveal a stairwell where you can find a medicine woman who will sell you {{im/loz|Item|Red Potions}} or {{im/loz|Item|Water of Lifes}} if you have already shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}}.
|
|The {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}} unlocks many desert secrets.  Blow the whistle here and a staircase will be revealed.  Descend down the stairs to find a {{im/loz|Item|Red Moblin}} that will give you 10 {{im/loz|Item|Rupees}}.
|-
! 4
|Inside the tree, you will discover [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 1|level one]].
|Travel west along the bridge to find the entrance to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 1|first dungeon]].
!''See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 4|Section 4]]''
|The {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}} is a far more important tool in the 2nd quest.  By blowing the whistle in this area, you will discover a staircase.  Travel down the stairs to find a rare {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}}.
|
|}
